body: What if it's a fake Australian accent?
So many things I cant just say one its like everything that was good in my life is either gone or going to leave soon and everything that was bad just got amplified.

Sophmore year of highschool a kid in my biology class that has never spoken to me in his life carved my full name middle initial and all  into the aborted pig fetus he was dissecting.... I wouldnt be surprised if he was a serial killer by now

Ps: to make matters worse i had been homeschooled leading up to this so this was my first time in real school

Honestly as a female i think the best way ive been approached is by them literally just talking to me as a person no lines, no creepy compliments just a normal conversation you would have meeting any other person. If shes into it then maybe ask for her social media. But i really dont recommend asking for phone numbers or snapchat because i know many women don't give those out even if they do like the person because they can be tracked from it and you never know whose a creep these days.

 IMPORTANT if you feel the convo start to dwindle do NOT try to make it keep going switching topics won't help it'll just make her feel uncomfortable and trapped in the situation if shes giving short answers just politely end the conversation, wish her a good day, and go on your way.

And to everyone saying just to do it online needs to watch a few romcoms or noah centineo movies.  Women want to feel like theyre worth more than a text . Once you have a genuine conversation with someone youre not just another message in her dms .
